final: WITH ch AS (SELECT o.orderbase AS ob, AVG(f.feerate) AS a FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault WHERE f.feerate IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.orderbase), overall AS (SELECT AVG(f.feerate) AS g FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault WHERE f.feerate IS NOT NULL) SELECT AVG(a) AS mean_channel_avg_feerate, AVG(a - g) AS mean_excess_over_overall FROM ch, overall WHERE a > g
